fields.label: Largest circuit: growth
fields.formula: gC = log(Lc₆ / Lc₄) / log(N₆ / N₄), N = tiles in the patch
fields.description: The exponent a in "length of the largest circuit ∝ N^a". 0 bounded, about 0.7 for triangle outlines, about 0.9 for thin wandering circuits, 1 for space-filling ones. Above 1 means the biggest circuit at level 4 was still cut open by the patch edge.

fields.label: Longest open strand: growth
fields.formula: gO = log(Lo₆ / Lo₄) / log(N₆ / N₄)
fields.description: The same exponent for the longest strand that reaches the edge of the patch.

fields.label: Largest circuit: dimension from growth
fields.formula: dC = 2 × gC
fields.description: Twice gC: roughly the fractal dimension of the largest circuit, if it spans the patch. A patch of N tiles is about N^½ tiles wide, so a curve of dimension d across it is about N^(d/2) long. About 1.4 for triangle outlines, 1.9 for thin circuits, 2 for space-filling ones. Only meaningful between 1 and 2; values above 2 are an artefact of the level-4 circuit being cut short.

fields.label: Longest open strand: dimension from growth
fields.formula: dO = 2 × gO
fields.description: Twice gO: roughly the fractal dimension of the longest open strand. About 2 for an infinite space-filling line.

fields.label: Largest circuit: mass-radius dimension
fields.formula: dCr = log(Lc₆ / Lc₄) / log(Rg₆ / Rg₄), Rg = radius of gyration
fields.description: Fractal dimension from the largest circuit's length against its own radius, not the patch's. It agrees with dC when the biggest circuit grows with the patch and does not depend on it spanning the patch. 0 when the circuit does not grow (its radius grows by less than 1.5 times), where no dimension can be read off.

fields.label: Largest circuit: growth, level 4 → 5
fields.formula: log(Lc₅ / Lc₄) / log(N₅ / N₄)
fields.description: One-level growth exponent. Triangle circuits grow on alternate levels, so this and the 5 → 6 step often flicker between about 0 and about 1.4 while their average (gC) stays steady.

fields.label: Largest circuit: growth, level 5 → 6
fields.formula: log(Lc₆ / Lc₅) / log(N₆ / N₅)
fields.description: The next one-level step. Plot it against the 4 → 5 step to see the alternating-level rhythm.

fields.label: Longest open strand: growth, level 4 → 5
fields.formula: log(Lo₅ / Lo₄) / log(N₅ / N₄)
fields.description: One-level growth exponent of the longest open strand.

fields.label: Longest open strand: growth, level 5 → 6
fields.formula: log(Lo₆ / Lo₅) / log(N₆ / N₅)
fields.description: The next one-level step of the longest open strand.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: fill
fields.formula: segments / (hull area × segments per unit area of the whole patch)
fields.description: Its segments over what its convex hull holds at average density. About 1 space-filling, small for an outline or a thread.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: enclosed area / hull
fields.formula: area inside the circuit (shoelace) / convex hull area
fields.description: How much of its convex hull the circuit encloses. Triangle outlines about 0.6, thin circuits about 0.2.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: triangularity
fields.formula: hull area / area of the smallest equilateral triangle around the hull (any rotation)
fields.description: How close its hull is to an equilateral triangle: 1 for a triangle, 0.67 for a regular hexagon, 0.6 for a disk.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: elongation
fields.formula: √(λ₁ / λ₂), the principal moments of its points
fields.description: How stretched it is: 1 for a round or triangular shape, large for a long thin one.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: radius of gyration
fields.formula: Rg = √(mean squared distance of its points from their centre), in tile edge lengths
fields.description: How big the biggest circuit is. It stays a few edges for bounded loops and reaches a good part of the patch for growing classes.

fields.label: Longest open strand: fill
fields.formula: as for the circuit fill
fields.description: How much of its convex hull the longest open strand covers. Infinite lines fill their region; cut-open triangle outlines do not.

fields.label: Longest open strand: elongation
fields.formula: √(λ₁ / λ₂)
fields.description: How stretched the longest open strand is. Slivers cut off along the patch edge are very elongated.

fields.label: Longest open strand: triangularity
fields.formula: hull area / smallest enclosing equilateral triangle
fields.description: How close its hull is to an equilateral triangle. A triangle outline cut open by the patch edge still scores high.

fields.label: Share of segments on open strands
fields.formula: segments on strands that reach the patch edge / all segments
fields.description: How much of the drawing reaches the patch edge. Near 1 when one or a few lines carry everything, small when nearly everything closes up.

fields.label: Share on the longest strand
fields.formula: segments of the largest component / all segments
fields.description: How much of the drawing one strand carries, open or closed. High for an infinite line that carries most of the drawing.

fields.label: Share on the 4 longest strands
fields.formula: segments of the four largest components / all segments
fields.description: How much of the drawing the four largest strands carry, open or closed.

fields.label: Share on circuits of 64+ segments
fields.formula: segments on circuits at least 64 long / all segments
fields.description: How much of the drawing is in big circuits.

fields.label: Longest circuit at level 4
fields.formula: Lc₄, in segments
fields.description: Length of the longest circuit at level 4.

fields.label: Longest circuit at level 5
fields.formula: Lc₅, in segments
fields.description: Length of the longest circuit at level 5.

fields.label: Longest circuit at level 6
fields.formula: Lc₆, in segments
fields.description: Length of the longest circuit at level 6.

fields.label: Longest open strand at level 4
fields.formula: Lo₄, in segments
fields.description: Length of the longest open strand at level 4.

fields.label: Longest open strand at level 5
fields.formula: Lo₅, in segments
fields.description: Length of the longest open strand at level 5.

fields.label: Longest open strand at level 6
fields.formula: Lo₆, in segments
fields.description: Length of the longest open strand at level 6.

fields.label: Number of circuits
fields.formula: count of closed strands
fields.description: How many circuits the level-6 patch holds.

fields.label: Number of open strands
fields.formula: count of strands with an end on the patch edge
fields.description: How many strands reach the patch edge at level 6. Mostly set by the rule and the patch outline, since every strand crossing the edge counts.

fields.label: Circuits per tile
fields.formula: number of circuits / tiles
fields.description: How many circuits there are for each tile. High for many small loops.

fields.label: Distinct circuit lengths
fields.formula: number of different circuit lengths (capped at 255)
fields.description: Low for a few repeated loop shapes, high for a hierarchy of sizes.

fields.label: Max nested at level 4
fields.formula: max over circuits of the number of circuits around it
fields.description: The deepest nesting at level 4.

fields.label: Max nested at level 6
fields.formula: max over circuits of the number of circuits around it
fields.description: The most circuits enclosing any one circuit at level 6. Circuits cut open by the patch edge enclose nothing.

fields.label: Nest sum at level 4
fields.formula: sum over circuits of the number of circuits around it
fields.description: Every circuit's depth added up at level 4.

fields.label: Nest sum at level 6
fields.formula: sum over circuits of the number of circuits around it
fields.description: Every circuit's depth added up at level 6: +1 for every circuit inside another circuit, counted once for each circuit around it.

fields.label: Circuits inside another
fields.formula: count of circuits with depth at least 1
fields.description: How many circuits sit inside at least one other circuit at level 6.

fields.label: Nest sum: growth
fields.formula: log((1 + nest sum₆) / (1 + nest sum₄)) / log(N₆ / N₄)
fields.description: How fast nesting grows with the patch. 1 means the nest sum grows in step with the tile count, as it does when circuits of every size keep nesting; above 1, depth keeps increasing too. The +1 keeps patterns without nesting at 0.

fields.label: Bridges
fields.formula: number of strands running from the patch edge to the patch edge
fields.description: Every open strand is a bridge: it enters and leaves the patch, cutting it in two. Includes the tiny ones that clip a corner of the patch.

fields.label: Bridge ratio: mean
fields.formula: mean over bridges of (smaller side's area in tiles) / (tiles the bridge crosses)
fields.description: How much patch a bridge cuts off per tile of its own length, averaged. Most bridges are short strands near the edge, so this is usually small.

fields.label: Bridge ratio: min
fields.formula: min over bridges of (smaller side in tiles) / (tiles crossed)
fields.description: The least efficient bridge. Usually a strand that clips a corner of the patch and cuts off almost nothing.

fields.label: Bridge ratio: max
fields.formula: max over bridges of (smaller side in tiles) / (tiles crossed)
fields.description: The best bridge: the most patch cut off per tile of strand. A high value is a short strand that still splits off a big region, a good bridge-building pattern.

fields.label: Best bridge: share cut off
fields.formula: smaller side of the best bridge / area of the patch
fields.description: How much of the patch the best bridge cuts off. 0.5 would be a clean halving.

fields.label: Best bridge: length
fields.formula: tiles crossed by the best bridge
fields.description: How long the best bridge is, in tiles.

levels: Growth from level 4 to level 6; everything else at level 6 unless the field says otherwise.

GROW.meaning: gC or gO at or above this: the strand keeps growing with the patch

STATIC.meaning: below this: it has stopped growing

LINE_G.meaning: an open strand growing like N^1 or faster is a space-filling infinite line

LINE_FO.meaning: ...and open strands must carry at least this share of all segments

SLIVER.meaning: open strands at least this elongated are cut-offs along the patch edge, not lines

OFILL.meaning: ...and a line fills its hull; a cut-open triangle outline does not

FILL.meaning: a circuit covering this share of its hull is space-filling

TRI.meaning: hull area over the smallest enclosing equilateral triangle: triangular at or above this

FAT.meaning: enclosed area over hull area: a triangle outline encloses at least this much

THIN.meaning: enclosed area over hull area: a thin thread encloses less than this
